anchors.quote: من سامری می‌خوام بفهمم که چرا من باید
بقیه چیزاش کاملاً جنراله هیچ چیزی نگفته که این
اومده تو این ۶ سالو چی به دست آورده

claim_en: From the summary the hiring manager wants to understand why to hire the candidate; for the DevOps CV (CV#01) it was completely general and said nothing about what was achieved in six years.
quote_en: From the summary I want to understand why I should [hire the candidate]. / Everything else in it is completely general; it said nothing [about] what [the candidate] achieved in these 6 years.

anchors.quote: من با ریکروترهای متفاوتی از شرکت‌های مختلف صحبت کردم به عنوان همکار
خیلی از ریکروترا اصلاً نمی‌دونن که این انگلیش تستا چیه تافل چیه؟ آیس چیه؟

claim_en: From talking with recruiters at different companies, the hiring manager says many recruiters do not even know what English tests such as TOEFL or IELTS are.
quote_en: I have talked with different recruiters from different companies as colleagues. / Many recruiters do not even know what these English tests are, what TOEFL is, what IELTS is.

anchors.quote: پس من توصیه می‌کنم این آی س۳ ش ه۷ و نیم اینجا مثلاً نباشه
این آیلسه رم به نظرم کلاً بردارید

claim_en: Remove the IELTS score from the CV.
quote_en: So I recommend that this IELTS 7.5 not be here. / I think remove this IELTS altogether.

anchors.quote: یه سری لیستا رو اومده دسته‌بندی کرده که کار خوبیه

claim_en: For the DevOps CV (CV#01), the hiring manager calls the skills list grouped into categories a good thing.
quote_en: [The candidate] has grouped the lists into categories, which is a good thing.

anchors.quote: این رزومه اینفراستراکچرش کجاست این چرا هیچ چیزی نداره نه ایبلی اس داره نه جی سی پی داره نه آژور داره
دواب که ایبلیوس یا جی سی پی بلد نباشه این رزومه ریجکته به نظر من
این بهونه برای اونا رضایت‌بخش نیست
من انتظار دارم وقتی یه دواپس استخدام می‌کنم بیاد واسه من کار کنه از فردا

claim_en: The hiring manager rejects a DevOps CV (CV#01) with no AWS, GCP or Azure: lack of access to them is not an accepted excuse, because a DevOps hire is expected to be productive from day one.
quote_en: Where is this CV's infrastructure, why does it have nothing, no AWS, no GCP, no Azure? / A DevOps engineer who does not know AWS or GCP: this CV is a reject, in my view. / This excuse [no access from Iran] does not satisfy them. / When I hire a DevOps engineer I expect them to work for me from tomorrow.

anchors.quote: این کاری که الان کردم توی مثلاً ۵ ثانیه ۱۰ ثانیه انجام میشه

claim_en: The check that rejected the DevOps CV (looking for the required tech stack) takes the hiring manager about 5 to 10 seconds when reading alone.
quote_en: What I just did takes, say, 5 or 10 seconds.

value.condition: checking a CV for the required tech stack

anchors.quote: سریع بررسی می‌کنی چون دنبال اون تک استکهایی می‌گردی که خودت میخوای بگیری

claim_en: Reading a CV, the hiring manager checks quickly for the tech stacks they want to hire for.
quote_en: You check quickly, because you are looking for the tech stacks you want to hire for.

anchors.quote: کور استرنجم ما نیاز نداریم دیگه اینو باید تو اون بالا می‌گفتی یا تو تو این بولت پوینت باید می‌گفتی

claim_en: A separate list of courses is not needed; mention them in the summary or the bullet points instead.
quote_en: We do not need the course list either; you should have said it up there or in these bullet points.

anchors.quote: معدل شما رو ما نیاز نداریم هیچکی براش ش مهم نیست

claim_en: The GPA is not needed on the CV; in the hiring manager's view nobody cares about it.
quote_en: We do not need your GPA; nobody cares about it.

anchors.quote: این رفرنسم که کلاً هیچ چیزی نمی‌رسونه اینجا

claim_en: A references section conveys nothing on the CV.
quote_en: This references section conveys nothing at all.

anchors.quote: می‌تونه خیلی راحت رزومشو یه صفحه کنه و با این چیزایی که گفتیم

claim_en: The six-year DevOps CV (CV#01) could easily be one page.
quote_en: [The candidate] could very easily make the CV one page, with the things we said.

anchors.quote: سافت اسکیل نیازی نیست بخش سافت اسکیل داشته باشیم
کسی که ۶ سال تجربه کار داره من باید سافت اسکیلاشو توی همین بولت پوینتها سامریش ببینم

claim_en: No soft skills section is needed: with six years of experience, the soft skills should show in the bullet points and the summary; listing teamwork or leadership is only a statement.
quote_en: There is no need for a soft skills section. / For someone with 6 years of experience I should see the soft skills in the bullet points and the summary.

anchors.quote: چهجوری ما میخوایم که دستاوردش کنیم و ترجیحاً یه چیزی که قابل سنجش باشه هم توش بذاریم

claim_en: Asked about outcome-first bullet points, the hiring manager says bullet points should state an achievement, preferably with something measurable.
quote_en: How we want to make it an achievement, and preferably also put something measurable in it.
